glosses: To shock or stimulate into sudden activity, as if by electric shock.

examples.text: The girl’s picture helped galvanize public opinion against the administration’s policy.

As described by Jaal, infighting was used as a means of conquest by the kett, but the presence of a common enemy eventually galvanized the angara to work together. glosses: To electrify, as by galvanism.

examples.text: The agitations resembled the grinnings and writhings of a galvanized corpse, not the struggles of an athletic man.
